additionalAbilities.description: Shuu makes three quarterstaff attacks when he takes the Attack action.
additionalAbilities.name: Multiattack

additionalAbilities.description:
Bonus Action; three uses. While raging, Shuu has Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison and Thunder damage, and +2 damage with Strength attacks. Rage ends early if Shuu is Incapacitated, dons Heavy armor, or does not extend it; it can last up to 10 minutes. One use returns on a Short Rest; all return on a Long Rest.

additionalAbilities.description: Weapon attacks and Unarmed Strikes score a Critical Hit on a natural 19 or 20. Shuu has Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. Immediately after scoring a Critical Hit, he can move up to half his speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. During combat, if Shuu starts his turn without Heroic Inspiration, he gains it.
additionalAbilities.name: Champion

additionalAbilities.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, Shuu can take one additional action on his turn, except the Magic action.
additionalAbilities.name: Action Surge

additionalAbilities.description: After attacking with his quarterstaff as part of the Attack action, Shuu can use a Bonus Action for a Pole Strike. He can also use his Reaction to make a quarterstaff or pike attack against a creature entering its reach.
additionalAbilities.name: Polearm Master

additionalAbilities.description: While holding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapon, Shuu gains +2 damage with that weapon. Included in his one-handed quarterstaff damage.
additionalAbilities.name: Dueling

additionalAbilities.description: Shuu has Resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage.
additionalAbilities.name: Celestial Resistance

additionalAbilities.description: Shuu knows the Light cantrip. Charisma is his spellcasting ability for it.
additionalAbilities.name: Light Bearer

additionalAbilities.description: Once per Long Rest, Shuu can use a Bonus Action to transform for 1 minute, choosing Heavenly Wings, Inner Radiance, or Necrotic Shroud. Once on each of his turns, one target he damages with an attack or spell takes an extra 5 damage: Necrotic for Necrotic Shroud, Radiant for the other forms.
additionalAbilities.name: Celestial Revelation
